allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Orient Green Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on August 14, 2025 with the Unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2025 along with Statement of Deviation/ Variation of funds raised through rights issue for equity shares pursuant to Regulation 32(1) of SEBI LODR for the quarter ended June 30, 2025
